source: services/legacy-billing/db/seed.sql (schema services/legacy-billing/db/schema.sql) loaded into PostgreSQL 16 database billing_<NS>, schema billing, by .migration/fixtures/legacy_billing_source.sh (docker-compose.procs.yml service legacy-billing-db). This is the live source of record for the run (d-source-mode=live), not a copy or export of it.
masking_note: not applicable: the seed is synthetic demo data (tenants 'Tenant One'..'Tenant Nine', fixed UUIDs); no real PII exists to mask.

fingerprints.fingerprint_basis: procs/transcripts/FIXTURE_SHA and SOURCE_SHA as computed by procs/harness/fingerprints.py (FIXTURE_SHA = schema.sql + seed.sql; SOURCE_SHA = services/legacy-billing/db/procs/*.sql); recomputed and equal at produced_at

row_counts_basis: .migration/data_profile.json row_bytes.rows_seen per table (origin live, sampled false), equal to the INSERT rows in seed.sql; total 49 rows across 11 tables. Answers the census finding row_estimate_missing (never-analyzed catalog).

tenants->subscriptions.note: every tenant has exactly one subscription

rating_periods->usage_events.source: derived from seed.sql; not in data_profile.json because usage_events has no FK to rating_periods (only tenant_id). The legacy join is tenant_id + occurred_at::date BETWEEN period_start AND period_end (services/legacy-billing/db/procs/rating.sql, fn_entitlement / fn_usage_breakdown).
rating_periods->usage_events.note: all three rating periods belong to tenant 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 (2025-11, 2025-12, 2026-01); that tenant's only usage event is dated 2026-02-10, outside every period, so no period contains a usage event

invoices->invoice_lines.outlier_parent: invoices 60000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 (tenant Two, status overdue) holds both invoice_lines; the other two invoices have none

plans->subscriptions.outlier_parent: plans 10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 (STARTER) holds 6 of 9 subscriptions; the largest fan-out anywhere in the fixture

coverage_gaps_for_s3.1: Scale: 49 rows total, largest fan-out 6 (plans->subscriptions), largest embed_bytes 354 B (data_profile embed_bytes plans->subscriptions). No parent approaches any embed/fan-out threshold (e.g. no tenant above 1000 usage_events), so threshold behaviour and 16 MB document-size handling are not exercised by this fixture. Known gap; the seed is not enlarged because that changes FIXTURE_SHA and invalidates procs/transcripts.
rating_periods->usage_events is empty (see fan_out): rating over real usage is not exercised by the data at rest; rely on the procs parity scenarios for that path.

Only tenant One has rating_periods; the three invoices (tenants Two, Five, Six) reference tenant One's rating_periods via period_id, so invoice.period_id crosses tenants. A model that embeds invoices under rating_periods or under tenants must handle this shape.
Three tables hold a single row (dunning_attempts, notifications) or two (invoice_lines); recon on them proves correctness, not volume.
